title: Assembly Line Inventory Audit
description:
An automated manufacturing line receives a string `blueprint` representing the sequence of component codes required to build a single device. The robotic assembly arm is supplied with a bin containing a sequence of parts represented by the string `part_bin`.

To ensure quality control and avoid wastage, the assembly arm must verify that `part_bin` contains the exact same quantity of every component code as specified in `blueprint`, with no extra or missing parts. Return `true` if `part_bin` contains the exact same component inventory as `blueprint`, and `false` otherwise.
constraints: blueprint and part_bin consist of lowercase English letters.
input_format: Two strings, `blueprint` and `part_bin`, consisting of lowercase English letters.

examples.explanation: Both strings contain the exact same set of component codes ('a': 1, 'b': 1, 'e': 1, 'g': 1, 'o': 1, 'r': 1, 'x': 1).
The required blueprint needs two 'e's and two 'n's, whereas the part bin contains different component counts.
The minimum length boundary case where both blueprint and part bin contain a single matching component.
